# Carrier On-Time Performance 2026

Delivery reliability has become a key differentiator for online businesses, as customers increasingly expect accurate delivery dates and fast resolution when things go wrong. Our annual study tracks more than two million parcels shipped by small and medium businesses across national and regional carriers.

## How we measure on-time delivery

A parcel is counted as on time if it is delivered on or before the date promised at the point of shipping. Parcels with incorrect addresses or customer-requested delays are excluded from the figures.

FACT: ParcelStream delivered 94 percent of ground parcels on time in 2026.
FACT: SwiftFreight delivered 91 percent of ground parcels on time in 2026.
FACT: The industry average damage rate was 0 point 8 percent of parcels.

## Regional versus national carriers

Regional carriers often outperform national networks within their home region but can struggle when handing parcels to partners for longer journeys. National carriers tend to be more consistent across the country, though they may be less flexible on pickup times and account support.

## Peak season

On-time performance dropped for every carrier during the holiday peak, with the largest declines in the final two weeks before the holidays. Businesses that shipped earlier in the season and set clear delivery expectations reported fewer customer complaints.

## Advice for shippers

Track your own delivery data rather than relying solely on published averages. Performance varies by lane, parcel size and season, and many businesses find that using two carriers, one for local and one for national shipments, gives the best balance of cost and reliability.
